validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_1127_state_cnt
FROM customer_case AS cc
WHERE cc.case_id = 1127
AND cc.state = 'in_progress';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_888_update_cnt
FROM customer_case AS cc
WHERE cc.case_id = 888
AND cc.priority = 'high'
AND cc.state = 'resolved';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_1127_sla_cnt
FROM case_sla AS s
WHERE s.case_id = 1127
AND s.sla_def_id = 1
AND s.stage = 'in_progress';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_1127_sla_cnt
FROM case_sla AS s
WHERE s.case_id = 1127
AND s.sla_def_id = 6
AND s.stage = 'in_progress';
